spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shaken, agitated, set in motion.
E.
प्र before नृत to dance, causal v., क्त aff.

mf. (-लः-ली)
A water-course, a canal.
E.
प्र before नल to go, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
प्र and नि before हन to kill or hurt, ल्युट् aff., and the radical letters changed.

mfn. (-शुः-शुः-शु)
High, tall, lofty.
E.
प्र before अंशु a ray of light.

m. (-न्तः)
Edge, margin, border, end.
E.
प्र before अन्त end.

ind.
Bordering, marginally, along or upon the extremity.
E.
प्रान्त the edge, and तसि aff.

n. (-र्गं)
A suburb or collection of houses out of the walls of the town, a Petta, &c.
E.
प्रान्त skirting, टुर्ग the fort.

n. (-रं)
1 A long and unshaded road, a lonesome or tiresome path.
2 A forest.
3 The hollow of a tree.
E.
प्र considerable, अन्तर space.

n. (-न्यं)
A long and tiresome road.
E.
प्रान्तर spacious, and शून्य empty, void.
